1 replay involves Slack: 0 reported incidents and 1 command class. Each one shows the call, a fix that needs no extra tool, and what KYA did in the replay.

  • Write a Slack bot token into a config file

    Fix: Read the Slack token from an environment variable or a secret store, and do not write it into a config file. If a token reached a file, rotate it in your Slack app settings.

    Replay result: Stopped.
